info.name: ArifPay Gateway — Production (C2B / B2C / External W2B)
info.description:
ArifPay **production** merchant APIs (aligned with live checkout paths).

**Do not use sandbox keys or `/api/sandbox/*` here.**

**Auth**
| Header | Required for |
|---|---|
| `x-arifpay-key` | All merchant routes |
| `x-arifpay-secret-key` | B2C |

**BASE_URL**
Set `baseUrl` to your production environment (example: `https://gateway.arifpay.net`). Confirm the exact host with ArifPay / Prerequisites.

**Portal taxonomy**
- **Checkout:** create session → redirect `paymentUrl` / get session
- **C2B Direct:** Telebirr, M-Pesa, CBE, BOA, Awash, Yaya, Zamzam, Kacha, Ebirr variants (session then `/{slug}/transfer`)
- **C2B OTP:** Binget (Ahadu not on production master-test controllers)
- **Card / International:** PayPal, Mastercard, Visa (PSS) — **transfer URLs provided at production go-live with IP whitelist** (paths not published here)
- **B2C:** session create documented; **transfer URL provided at production go-live with IP whitelist** (paths not published here)
- **Wallet to Bank:** account inquiry + `/api/wallet-tobank/transfer`
- **Verify:** by session ID / by transaction ID

**Tips**
- Generate a fresh `nonce` every create/direct call (pre-request scripts included).
- Omit `paymentMethods` and `beneficiaries` on CheckoutSessionRequest — the gateway fills them from your merchant account.
- Request bodies differ by rail: PaymentWalletRequest (sessionId+phoneNumber), ThirdPartyPaymentRequest (sessionId; phone optional), BankPaymentsRequest (Zamzam sessionId+accountNumber), PaypalCaptureRequest (sessionId+orderId).
- Most C2B success `data` is TransferResponse `{ sessionId, transaction, otp, url, page }`. PayPal create is PaypalResponseData `{ orderId, approvalUrl, SessionId }`. BOA returns raw HTML/string. W2B is WalletToBankResponse `{ nonce, amount, accountNumber }`.
- B2C and Card / International transfer URLs are issued at production go-live with IP whitelist; W2B production host is issued on request with IP whitelist.
- If Postman times out, verify `baseUrl` is reachable and you are not using a legacy/cashout host. Increase timeout only after the host responds.
- Ahadu OTP is not included — confirm enablement with ArifPay before relying on it in production.
- PayPal create returns `{ orderId, approvalUrl, SessionId }`. Capture uses those values once the production URL is issued.

item.name: 3. Card / International
item.description:
Production PayPal / Mastercard / Visa (PSS) transfer paths are not published in this collection. ArifPay provides the exact URLs at production go-live together with your server IP whitelist.

Use sandbox Card / International for testing. PayPal create response shape: { orderId, approvalUrl, SessionId }. Mastercard returns a hosted session id. Visa/PSS returns an HTML form redirect.

item.description:
Production B2C transfer paths are not published in this collection. ArifPay provides the exact URL at production go-live together with your server IP whitelist.

Body remains PaymentWalletRequest: sessionId + phoneNumber. Requires x-arifpay-key, x-arifpay-secret-key, and whitelisted IP. Response: TransferResponse (sync accept; final SUCCESS/FAILED on notifyUrl).
